name: Stocks
author: WinDock
description: Stock, ETF and crypto quotes from Finnhub: one symbol at a time or every symbol in a row or a list, with the change since the previous close and a popup with the day's figures. Needs a free Finnhub API key.

settings.label: Data source
settings.description: Where the quotes come from. Finnhub (finnhub.io) has a free plan with 60 requests a minute.

settings.label: API key
settings.description: Your Finnhub API key (free at finnhub.io/register). Empty: nothing is fetched.

settings.label: Symbols
settings.description: Ticker symbols separated by commas, as Finnhub spells them: AAPL, MSFT, SPY, BINANCE:BTCUSDT, OANDA:EUR_USD.

settings.label: View
settings.description: One symbol at a time (the wheel steps through them), or every symbol at once. Default: every symbol.

settings.label: Switch symbol every
settings.description: One symbol at a time: show the next symbol after this many seconds; 0 keeps the chosen one. Default: 0.

settings.label: Refresh every
settings.description: How often new quotes are fetched (one request per symbol). Default: 5.

settings.label: Clicking the widget
settings.description: What a click does: open the popup with the day's figures, fetch new quotes, or nothing. Default: the popup.

settings.label: A symbol in the popup opens
settings.description: The web page a click on a symbol's row in the popup opens. Default: Yahoo Finance.

settings.label: Change shown
settings.description: The change since the previous close, as a percentage, an amount, both, or not at all. Default: percent.

settings.label: Show the symbol
settings.description: Writes the ticker symbol above the price. On by default.

settings.label: Arrows before the change
settings.description: A small triangle up or down before the change. On by default.

settings.label: Sparkline
settings.description: A small graph of the prices fetched over the last day, beside the price. Off by default.

settings.label: Layout of every symbol
settings.description: Every symbol: side by side in one row, or a list with a line per symbol. Automatic: a row on a top or bottom dock, a list on a left or right dock and on the desktop. Default: automatic.

choices.label: Automatic (a top or bottom dock: a row; else a list)

settings.label: Up colour
settings.description: The colour of a change above zero. Default: green.

settings.label: Down colour
settings.description: The colour of a change below zero. Default: red.

settings.label: Background
settings.description: What is drawn behind the widget: nothing, a dark panel, or the theme's label panel. Default: none.
